name: PRINCE MINI
description: Multi-user WhatsApp bot with web pairing and automatic updates.

OWNER_NUMBER.description: Your WhatsApp number with country code, digits only (e.g. 255712345678)

UPDATE_REPO.description: GitHub repo to pull updates from, e.g. yourname/prince (must be public for .update now on Heroku)

HEROKU_APP_NAME.description: The name you give this Heroku app (needed for .update now)

HEROKU_API_KEY.description: Token from: heroku authorizations:create (keep it secret)

GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET.description: Random secret you also paste into the GitHub webhook (enables instant deploy on push)

TURNSTILE_SITEKEY.description: Cloudflare Turnstile site key (human check on the pairing page)
